findings.result: The finalizer waits for an existing parseable native XBEL bookmark list; it does not create a replacement native list, launch applications or alter device labels/mounts.
Mounted Atomic root/system block entries and typed Solid drive properties must be available. Two consecutive complete classified inventories must match within a bounded timeout.
Existing explicit IsHidden values remain untouched. Unknown/removable/hotplug and data-bearing shared root/home volumes are excluded from the hide policy.
The existing writer emits actual-change immutable records after a successful write; the schema remains compatible with the independent restore helper. No ownership is inferred from hidden state.

The layout phase invokes finalizer with check=True before publishing completion. Host temporary-home tests confirm failure leaves the marker absent, next login retries, completed layout is not reapplied, and native setup system users receive no state.

runtime_acceptance_pending: Actual native first-user login must complete both phase markers without manual repair.
Fresh Dolphin must show expected hidden immutable-only entries while retaining the shared user-data volume.
Native bookmark/model updates are asynchronous; source stability checks do not prove the final on-screen state.
Second disk-only boot must retain marker hashes and effective sidebar/defaults.
